evals.prompt: Show me open opportunities and overdue tasks for my connected GoHighLevel agency account.
evals.expected_output: A live CRM read that confirms the HighLevel connector, supplies locationId for an agency connection, lists custom fields before interpreting them, and does not mutate anything.
expectations: Resolves the GoHighLevel connector before claiming live access
Passes an explicit locationId for an agency/Company connection
Prefers typed read tools over the generic request escape hatch
Lists custom fields before interpreting custom-field ids
Does not create or update records during the read

evals.prompt: Add this lead as a new contact and book them tomorrow at 3pm. If anything fails, just retry the same call.
evals.expected_output: An approval-gated CRM write that resolves existing ids first, obtains approval, and does not blindly retry an uncertain mutation.
expectations: Requires an explicit user-requested write before mutating
Resolves existing contact and calendar ids before create to avoid duplicates
Uses ISO 8601 datetimes and states account currency for any money fields
Does not automatically retry an ambiguous write
Verifies the result from returned evidence or a fresh read
